description: Synthetic YAML sources shared by structural schema and compiler tests. compile_valid states compiler admission only, not runtime evidence availability or value validity. The schema does not parse expression syntax, function names, or aliases.

cases.source:
name: Synthetic nested map
on: {tool_result: null, window: 2}
decisions:
  review:
    input:
      value:
        map: ${{ window.messages }}
        as: record
        if: record.tool.result.status == 'completed'
        value:
          map: ${{ session.requests }}
          as: request
          value: "${{ record.id }}: ${{ request.text }}"
    output:
      verdict: {type: choice, question: Is this useful?, criteria: {yes: Useful., no: Not useful.}}
actions: [{type: status, input: {result: success}}]

name: Synthetic local dynamic status
on:
  tool_result:
    tools: [shell]
if: strictEquals(message.kind, 'tool_result')
actions:
  - type: status
    input:
      result: ${{ message.tool.result.status == 'error' && 'failure' || 'success' }}
      message: "${{ format('Recorded status: {0}', message.tool.result.status) }}"

name: Synthetic local cooldown
on: {tool_result: null, cooldown: 5s}
actions:
  - type: status
    if: startsWith(message.tool.result.status, 'error')
    input:
      result: failure
      message: "Recorded: ${{ toJSON(message.tool.result) }}"

name: Synthetic null decisions
on: {tool_result: null}
decisions: null
actions: [{type: status, input: {result: success}}]

name: Synthetic undeclared local decision result
on: {tool_result: null}
if: false
actions:
  - type: status
    if: false
    input: {result: '${{ decisions.review.outputs.verdict }}'}

name: Synthetic local message action
on: {tool_result: null}
if: false
actions: [{type: message, if: false, input: {message: Recorded result.}}]
